title: Login button not working on mobile Safari
description: Tapping Login on iPhone does nothing, while desktop Chrome works.

title: Appointment calendar shows wrong date
description: Appointments appear one day earlier for patients in some time zones.

title: Transfer fails with timeout on slow networks
description: Fund transfers time out on 3G and the user is not sure if money moved.

title: Attendance report counts holidays as absent
description: Monthly attendance percentage drops because holidays are marked absent.

title: Flight search returns no results for round trips
description: Searching for return flights shows an empty list even though flights exist.

title: Cart empties after page refresh
description: Items disappear from the cart when the page reloads, for guests and signed-in users.

title: Patient search is case sensitive
description: Searching for 'sharma' does not find patients named 'Sharma'.

title: Account balance not refreshed after transfer
description: The balance on the home screen stays old until the app is restarted.

title: Report card shows wrong grade for 90 marks
description: Students scoring exactly 90 receive grade B instead of A.

title: Hotel prices shown without taxes
description: The final price at payment is higher than the price on the list.

title: Payment fails with expired card error for valid cards
description: Customers with cards expiring this year are told the card has expired.

title: Prescription print layout cuts off medicine names
description: Long medicine names are truncated on the printed prescription.

title: OTP not received on some carriers
description: Customers on two mobile carriers never receive the login OTP.

title: Timetable clashes not detected
description: The same teacher can be scheduled in two classes in the same period.

title: Booking confirmation shows wrong passenger name
description: With several travellers, the confirmation lists the first name for everyone.

title: Wrong total shown after applying discount code
description: Order total is higher than expected once a percentage coupon is applied.

title: Duplicate patient records created on double click
description: Double clicking Register creates two identical patient records.

title: Statement PDF shows wrong date range
description: The generated statement is missing transactions from the last day selected.

title: Fee receipt number repeats
description: Two parents received receipts with the same receipt number.

title: Seat selection map does not load
description: The seat map area stays blank for some airlines.
resolution_notes: Fixed the CORS configuration for the seat map service.

title: Search returns duplicate products
description: The same product appears two or three times in search results.
resolution_notes: A join on product variants created duplicates; added DISTINCT on product id.

title: Doctor schedule overlaps allowed
description: Two appointments can be booked for the same doctor at the same time.
resolution_notes: Added overlap validation on create and update, with tests.

title: Login blocked after three failed attempts forever
description: Users who mistype the password three times are never unlocked.
resolution_notes: The lock expiry job was never scheduled; added a 30 minute automatic unlock.

title: Parent login shows another child's marks
description: A parent with two children sees marks of a student from another family.
resolution_notes: Query was missing the student filter; added an ownership check and test.

title: Cancelled booking still charged
description: Customers who cancel are not refunded automatically.
resolution_notes: The refund job failed silently; added retries and alerting.

title: Order confirmation email not sent
description: Customers do not receive any email after placing an order.
resolution_notes: SMTP credentials had been rotated; updated settings and added an alert on send failures.

title: Lab report upload fails above 5 MB
description: Uploading scanned lab reports larger than 5 MB shows a generic error.
resolution_notes: Raised the upload limit and streamed files to storage instead of memory.

title: Biometric login crashes on Android 12
description: The app closes immediately when fingerprint login is used on Android 12.
resolution_notes: Updated the biometric library and handled the missing key store exception.

title: Bulk student import fails on special characters
description: Importing a CSV with names containing accents stops with an error.
resolution_notes: Read the CSV as UTF-8 with BOM and normalised names.

title: Date picker allows past dates
description: Users can choose a departure date earlier than today.
resolution_notes: Set the minimum date to today on all date pickers.

title: Product images load slowly on listing page
description: The category page takes over eight seconds to show product pictures.
resolution_notes: Full-size images were served; generated thumbnails and enabled lazy loading.

title: Wrong age calculated for newborn patients
description: Babies under one year are shown as 0 years with no months.
resolution_notes: Age calculation now shows months and days for patients under two years.

title: Currency conversion rounding error
description: Converted amounts differ by one paisa from the bank's rate sheet.
resolution_notes: Used decimal arithmetic with bankers rounding instead of floats.

title: Exam schedule printed in wrong order
description: Exams are listed by subject name instead of by date.
resolution_notes: Sorted by date and then by start time.

title: Currency shown incorrectly after changing region
description: Switching region keeps old currency symbols on some pages.
resolution_notes: Stored the currency preference in the session instead of per request.

title: Coupon can be reused unlimited times
description: A single-use coupon code still works on every new order.
resolution_notes: Usage count was never incremented; enforced a per-user limit with a unique constraint.

title: Billing total ignores insurance co-pay
description: Invoices do not include the patient co-pay amount.
resolution_notes: Included co-pay in the invoice calculation and added edge-case tests.

title: Push notifications duplicated
description: Each transaction alert arrives two or three times.
resolution_notes: Deduplicated device tokens on registration.

title: Teacher cannot edit marks after submission
description: Teachers need to correct a typo but the marks are locked.
resolution_notes: Added an unlock request flow approved by the principal.

title: Duplicate bookings on double payment click
description: Pressing Pay twice creates two bookings and two charges.
resolution_notes: Added an idempotency token to the payment request.

title: Password reset link expires immediately
description: The reset email link says it has expired as soon as it is clicked.
resolution_notes: Token timestamp mixed UTC and local time; unified everything to UTC.

title: Session expires during long consultation notes
description: Doctors lose unsaved notes when the session times out mid consultation.
resolution_notes: Extended session for signed-in clinicians and added autosave of notes.

title: Beneficiary list not sorted alphabetically
description: Saved payees appear in random order, making them hard to find.
resolution_notes: Added ordering by name to the query.

title: Library due date ignores weekends
description: Books fall due on Sundays when the library is closed.
resolution_notes: Used the school working-day calendar for due dates.

title: Mobile layout of itinerary is broken
description: Itinerary tables overflow the screen on phones.
resolution_notes: Replaced fixed widths with a responsive grid.

title: Add wishlist feature
description: Let customers save products to a wishlist and move them to the cart later.
resolution_notes: Implemented wishlist model, API and UI; released in version 1.4.

title: Add SMS appointment reminders
description: Send patients a reminder message the day before their appointment.
resolution_notes: Integrated an SMS provider with a 24-hour reminder job.

title: Add spending insights chart
description: Show a monthly breakdown of spending by category.
resolution_notes: Built the insights screen with category totals and a monthly chart.

title: Add online fee payment
description: Parents should be able to pay term fees online.
resolution_notes: Integrated the payment gateway and automatic receipts.

title: Add price alerts for flights
description: Notify users when a flight price drops below their target.
resolution_notes: Built price alert subscriptions with a daily check job.

title: Export order history to CSV
description: Customers want to download their past orders as a spreadsheet.
resolution_notes: Added a CSV export button on the orders page with date range filter.

title: Role based access for nurses
description: Nurses should see vitals and notes but not billing details.
resolution_notes: Added a nurse role with scoped permissions and updated menus.

title: Add scheduled transfers
description: Allow customers to schedule recurring transfers such as rent.
resolution_notes: Implemented scheduled and recurring transfers with reminders.

title: Add parent-teacher meeting scheduler
description: Let parents pick a free slot for the parent-teacher meeting.
resolution_notes: Built the slot booking page with confirmation messages.

title: Add loyalty points
description: Reward repeat customers with points redeemable on bookings.
resolution_notes: Implemented points earning and redemption at checkout.

title: Checkout crashes when address line is empty
description: The server returns a 500 error if the second address line is left blank.

title: Discharge summary shows another patient's data
description: A printed discharge summary contained details of a different patient.

title: Mini statement missing last transaction
description: The five-line mini statement omits the most recent entry.

title: Student photo upload rotates sideways
description: Photos taken on phones appear rotated after upload.

title: Airline logos missing on results
description: Several airlines show a blank square instead of a logo.

title: Upgrade payment gateway SDK to latest version
description: The current SDK is deprecated and will stop working at the end of the quarter.

title: Migrate patient database to new server
description: Move the production database to the new hardware with minimal downtime.

title: Upgrade encryption library
description: The current library has a published vulnerability and must be upgraded.

title: Archive previous academic year data
description: Move last year's records to an archive to keep the main tables fast.

title: Switch to new maps provider
description: The current maps API will be discontinued; migrate to the new provider.

title: Order status not updating after shipment
description: Orders stay on Processing even after the courier marks them as shipped.

title: Emergency admission form is too slow
description: The form takes about 20 seconds to load during peak hours.

title: Card block request stuck in pending
description: Blocking a lost card stays pending and the card still works.

title: Homework notifications not delivered
description: Parents do not get alerts when new homework is posted.

title: Hotel availability out of sync
description: Rooms shown as available are sold out at confirmation.

title: Add support for multiple currencies
description: Show prices and take payment in the customer's local currency.

title: Add barcode scanning for wristbands
description: Scan patient wristbands to open the record instead of typing the ID.

title: Add fingerprint approval for large transfers
description: Require biometric confirmation for transfers above a set limit.

title: Add bus tracking
description: Show the live location of the school bus to parents.

title: Add travel insurance add-on
description: Offer optional travel insurance during checkout.

title: Receptionist cannot reschedule appointments

title: Product reviews allow script tags
description: HTML typed into a review is rendered on the product page without escaping.

title: Audit log missing for record deletions
description: Deleted patient records leave no trace in the audit log.

title: Interest calculation off by one day
description: Savings interest is calculated for one day fewer in leap years.

title: Marks entry page freezes with 200 students
description: The page becomes unresponsive when a large class is loaded.

title: Search is slow during peak hours
description: Results take more than 30 seconds in the evening.

title: Add dark mode
description: Provide a dark theme option for the storefront and account pages.

title: Add multilingual patient forms
description: Offer registration forms in Hindi and Tamil as well as English.

title: Add QR code payments
description: Let users pay merchants by scanning a QR code.

title: Add multi-language report cards
description: Print report cards in the parent's preferred language.

title: Add train booking
description: Support booking train tickets alongside flights and hotels.

title: Set up automated database backups
description: Nightly backups with a restore test are needed for the production database.

title: Write user guide for new staff
description: Create a short guide covering registration, billing and reports.

title: Rotate API keys quarterly
description: Define and automate rotation of third-party API keys every quarter.

title: Clean up duplicate class sections
description: Several classes have two sections with the same name.

title: Document the booking API
description: Publish developer documentation for the booking endpoints.

title: Help with bulk product import format
description: A seller asks which columns are required for the CSV product import.

description: A customer asks what documents are needed to reactivate a dormant account.

title: Help with promoting students to next class
description: The office asks how to promote a whole class at the end of the year.

title: Help with refund status
description: A customer asks where to track the status of a refund.
